defects_found_and_repaired.description: CC-12 treated interpreter bytecode caches as a semantic checkout mutation, so every Python suite failed the gate.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Split the assertion: CC-12 blocks only non-bytecode mutation, CC-19 reports bytecode residue as an observation, and CC-20 measures why environment-based suppression does not work.

defects_found_and_repaired.found_by: the gate's own CC-05 assertion during REPRO-1
defects_found_and_repaired.description: The unit's first commit staged the __pycache__ directories the test run produced, so a pristine clone of the delivered commit started with build residue.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: git rm --cached the four tracked .pyc files and add a unit-scoped .gitignore.
defects_found_and_repaired.recurrence_test: REPRO-1 CC-05 on the delivered commit, plus test_committed_warm_build_residue_is_caught as the synthetic case

defects_found_and_repaired.found_by: CC-16 asserting PASS on a clean warm baseline
defects_found_and_repaired.description: The warm-baseline dirtiness check ran after the warm suite, so bytecode written by the warm run was misreported as a pre-existing uncommitted dependency.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Read warm-tree porcelain before executing anything in it.
defects_found_and_repaired.recurrence_test: test_portable_suite_passes_every_blocking_assertion asserts CC-16 PASS; test_uncommitted_file_dependency_is_caught asserts CC-16 INCONCLUSIVE with the offending path named

defects_found_and_repaired.description: The confinement assertion in the test excluded paths under the work root but not the work root entry itself, producing a false positive.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Exclude the work-root entry as well as its descendants.

defects_found_and_repaired.description: The rename fixture called git mv into a directory that did not exist.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Create the destination directory in the fixture.

defects_found_and_repaired.description: git config --get was passed --default after the key name, where git reads it as a value pattern.

measured_wall_time_observations.subject: WA-003 suite in the warm runner checkout with the inherited environment
measured_wall_time_observations.attributed_cause: commit.gpgsign=true in the inherited global git configuration, whose signer is the provider-installed program gpg.ssh.program=/home/ubuntu/.cursor/bin/cursor-git-ssh-keygen
isolation_evidence: ownership module alone, inherited environment: real 30.288s, user 0.384s
ownership module alone, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null: real 0.415s
ownership module alone, inherited environment with GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=commit.gpgsign GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false: real 0.423s
measured_wall_time_observations.conclusion: The slowdown is fully attributable to ambient commit signing. The near-identical figures for disabling all global configuration and for disabling only commit.gpgsign isolate the cause to that single setting.
